notes.title: Hookbots has been released!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34782722/b9d47605d6e040c13458c0d941274cfcff5f24fc.jpg

Hello everyone!

We are SUPER excited to share with you our game! We have invested TONS of hours to make this party game a reality, starting from a small prototype in a game jam in 2015, to a finished product with:


 Local multiplayer
 13 bots
 Loads of unlockables
 Multiple game modes
 Single player campaign
 Single player challenges,
 A bot factory to create your own bots.


We have been already receiving good reviews by media outlets and players alike!  We hope that you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed making it. If you do, please share with your friends as well as write a review!



- The Tree Interactive team
